# Weapon

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Attacks](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#Weapon)*

A weapon is an object that is in the Simple or Martial weapon category. *See also* "Equipment" ("[Weapons](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/equipment#Weapons)").
